display_long_description:
I am pleased to present you the opportunity to integrate the "Physics Laboratory" app into school education.
As a physics teacher with a passion for educational innovation, I developed this app with the goal of enriching student learning through the use of virtual reality.
"Physics Laboratory" is a virtual reality-based application designed to work with the Meta Quest 2 headset.
It offers students an immersive learning experience through simulations and virtual experiments.
The app aims to make physical concepts more accessible and tangible, encouraging interactivity and experimentation in a virtual environment.
Educational Benefits: The app offers several educational benefits, including:
Practical approach to physics concepts through virtual experiments.
Greater student involvement and motivation in learning.
Access to complex contexts that would otherwise be difficult to replicate in a traditional classroom setting.
The app is constantly improving, I'm working on new rooms (new Physics experiments).
I had my students try this app, it was a great success.
Languages: Italian and English.
This is a DEMO app.
